preamble: In many Chinese dialects the Middle Chinese aspirated initial 透 *tʰ lost its stop closure and became a glottal or velar fricative. Chang Kun (1994) surveys the change: in most dialects (e.g. Nanchang Gan) the result is h and merges with the 曉 initial, but in Danzhou (Hainan) and Wenchang Hainanese the 透 reflex is specifically velar x, kept apart from 曉, which is read h.

examples.from: 他 'he, other' (Middle Chinese 透 initial tʰ-)
examples.note: 透 initial read x, while the 曉 initial is h (花 ha 'flower').

examples.from: 吞 'swallow' (Middle Chinese 透 initial tʰ-)
腿 'leg' (Middle Chinese 透 initial tʰ-)
examples.note: 透 initial read x; 曉 words such as 毀 'destroy' have h (hui).
